title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.07107v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across A

translated_title: MemWM：记忆增强的基于文本的世界模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07107v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：世界模型越来越多地用于通过预测环境状态如何随智能体行为演变来支持智能体的规划。然而，流畅的下一状态预测仍可能遗漏任务关键事实、破坏产品属性或应用错误的转换规则。为解决此类系统性预测错误，我们引入了MemWM，一种记忆增强的基于文本的世界模型。MemWM使用世界记忆（world memory），一个包含转换规则、状态缓存和难以预测事实的精选记忆库，来条件化下一状态的想象。我们通过结构化状态保真度（SSF）评估事实状态的保留，该指标通过基准特定的事实和字段对预测状态进行评分。与SFT相比，记忆增强训练将SSF提升了高达206.3%。在完整规划设置中，我们保持策略模型冻结，并提供策略侧的世界技能：检索到的任务级技能和逐步纠正性指导用于行动选择。在A（基准）上...
tldr: 本文提出MemWM，一种记忆增强的基于文本的世界模型，通过引入世界记忆库来条件化下一状态预测，显著提升了事实状态保真度（SSF提升高达206.3%），并支持冻结策略模型下的规划任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model that conditions next-state imagination on a curated memory bank of transition rules and facts, improving Structured State Fidelity by up to 206.3% over SFT while supporting planning with a frozen policy model.
